title: Efficient Attention Mechanisms for Transformer Models
abstract: A survey of efficient attention mechanisms including sparse attention, linear attention, and flash attention techniques for reducing the quadratic complexity of standard transformer attention.

title: Retro Computing Interfaces in Modern Web Applications
abstract: Exploring the intersection of nostalgic UI design patterns (classic Mac OS, MS-DOS, early Windows) with modern web technologies like CSS custom properties, Canvas API, and TypeScript.

title: TypeScript in Large-Scale Frontend Architecture
abstract: Best practices for structuring large TypeScript frontend projects — module boundaries, type safety patterns, and migration strategies from JavaScript.
